Arrange grouped bars and lines

Source: R/arc-chart.R
set_position.Rd

Places the groups that set_color() creates beside each other, on top of each other, or stretched to fill the axis. A chart with a single group has nothing to arrange, so this does nothing until a colour column other than x splits it.

Usage

set_position(chart, position = "dodge")

Arguments

chart

Defines which chart to modify.

position

default "dodge". Defines how the groups are placed, one of "dodge", "stack", or "fill".

Value

chart, with its position adjustment set.

Examples

df <- data.frame(
  species = c("a", "a", "b"),
  island = c("x", "y", "x")
)

arc_bar(df, species) |>
  set_color(island) |>
  set_position("stack")
